verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents itself as 100% open-source and deployable on-premise. It describes Helm-based Kubernetes self-hosting, including a zero-config development chart and Kubernetes-native production workloads since 2.14, and lists an On Prem tier. Community users report deploying the open-source version easily. Missing for 10: a feature-complete deployment path without Kubernetes (docs say full features require a cluster), and independent hands-on corroboration of the current Helm-based setup (community reports are from the older Docker era).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Jitsu is 100% open-source and can be deployed to any on-premise infrastructure.
Run Jitsu yourself on Kubernetes with Helm, fully under your control.
A feature-complete Jitsu deployment requires a Kubernetes cluster
It was very easy and straightforward to get started, deploy and start collecting things (into BigQuery).
